title: Two Modes, One Site
summary:
Introduced a complete dual-mode architecture built around the idea of 0 → 1.

0 is the origin: dark, empty, baseline.
1 is the first departure from it: light, movement, a new beginning.

Alongside the redesign came a persistent progression system, hidden interactions, console commands, and a site-wide collection of easter eggs.
quote:
Zero is where you are.
One is proof you moved.
changes: Added Zero Mode — the original dark / void-inspired theme.
Added One Mode — a full white theme built around “1 means begin again.”
Added cinematic 0 → 1 and 1 → 0 transitions across the entire site.
Added persistent mode state through localStorage.
Added large environmental typography including ONE, BEGIN, START FROM ZERO, and other hidden references.
Added an invisible six-step progression system: [0] found nothing, [1] found something, [2] broke a baseline, [3] annoyed a pingu, [4] read the source, [5] reached the end.
Added a hidden 6/6 completion moment for anyone curious enough to find everything.
Expanded the Command Palette with secret queries: 0 → 0 results. perfect., 1 → one result: a new beginning., baseline → did you mean: break it?, nothing → you found it.
Added keyboard interactions: 0 → giant zero overlay + Zero Mode, 1 → white flash + One Mode, F → forking reality... permission denied.
Made the logo unnecessarily interactive: 2s hover → yes. still., 7 clicks → ego: NaN, 10 clicks → click_count = 10 / productivity = 0, double click → ilovebaselines → no.
Added project-page whispers including: some survived., things I broke first., baseline detected., baseline broken.
Added draggable-pingu project reviews: code review initiated. 🐧
Added Open Source / Licenses easter eggs: closed source detected: 0, good., fork me. I dare you., as it should be., beautiful., lawyers were here.
Added a five-click MIT license interaction because apparently that was necessary.
Added hidden Blog search responses and fake results for: nothing, 1, penguin.
Added a slow-scroll hidden post: you weren't supposed to find this.
Added an interactive version-history descent back to: v0.0 initial commit. added nothing. broke nothing. started anyway.
Added the permanent end-of-timeline release: v∞ still unfinished.
Exposed a tiny DevTools API: window.ihatebaselines.zero(), window.ihatebaselines.one(), window.ihatebaselines.pingu().
Added footer idle messages: 3s → ...still here?, 6s → seriously?, 9s → fine. +1 curiosity.
Added 0 rights reserved. → 1 chance reserved. hover interaction.
Added a minimalist loading screen built around the site name and a fading 0.
Removed all explicit scroll down labels and arrows.
